hypothesis: A daily ZigZag structure with two confirmed highs and one confirmed intervening low (or two lows and one high) defines parallel resistance and support. A completed candle rejecting either extreme produces a trade away from that boundary. Compare candle confirmation and 5%, 8%, opposite-line exits against the previous two-same-side-line rule.

research_provenance.note: The marked circles are visual examples without ticker or timestamps; exact trade matching cannot be asserted. Lines use only confirmed historical pivots.

parameter_rationale: Predeclared a=wing3/reversal2%/zone0.5%/age80, b=wing5/reversal4%/zone1%/age120. Test close-inside and directional candles; compare fixed 5%, 8% and opposite-channel exits. The old active rule is a nonpromotable control.
baseline: Same-stock buy-and-hold with 25% capital, plus old_d_a_trend_a4 fixed active-rule control on identical candles.
signal_rule: On each completed 1D candle, only already-confirmed ZigZag pivots are usable. The two latest highs form upper boundary and the latest confirmed low between them anchors a parallel lower boundary; if no intervening low, use a later confirmed low. Symmetrically, two lows plus one high define the channel. Prefer the most recently confirmed complete channel. Long when a candle touches or pierces support but closes inside; short when it touches or pierces resistance but closes inside. Variant may additionally require bullish/bearish candle body. At most one entry per boundary/channel. A close outside the zone invalidates that boundary. Signals fill at next open. Exit at 5%, 8%, opposite channel edge, or on close beyond active channel, executed next open. No intrabar target fill is assumed.
signal_semantics: 1D parallel-channel bounce from confirmed ZigZag pivots; no future pivots or backdated entries.
evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per symbol; this is not a combined portfolio.
execution_timing: Observe completed 1D candle; decide at its close; execute at next available candle open.
holding_period: Until target, opposite boundary, channel break or opposite entry.
rebalance_rule: No intrabar rebalance; at most one position per account.
availability_lag: A pivot is available after wing later daily candles; the signal uses only earlier confirmations.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Rank predeclared channel variants by early complete-month positive share and mean monthly net return; choose first train-ranked rule with liquid stocks above strict 10% latest complete 12-month after-cost gate. The old active rule is a control only. Late already-seen history is diagnostic.

untested_dependencies: exact user chart ticker/time not available

limitations: Pivot confirmation is delayed by wing days; plotting at the pivot center does not imply earlier tradability
A long wick through the line can enter only if the candle closes back inside the channel
2026 history has already been inspected in related ZigZag work
Corporate actions and short borrow are not fully covered
